dialogue.realtalk: Talk? Sure. Walk with me though — two more laps around the fences before sundown. Keep up, %1$s.
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.good: Great stretch. Beat my own time to the well three mornings running. Legs ache. The good ache.
dialogue.realtalk.checkin.rough: Rough week. Tried to outrun it twice and it kept pace. Thanks for asking, %1$s. Really.
dialogue.realtalk.day.good: Strong day. Up before the rooster, ten trips to the well, still bouncing. Count them — ten.
dialogue.realtalk.day.rough: Slow day. Tweaked my shoulder hauling water and now everything's uphill. Even the flat parts.
dialogue.realtalk.work.like: Love it. It's all reps. Lift, carry, repeat till dusk. Sleep like a rock, wake up hungry, go again.
dialogue.realtalk.work.hate: Honest answer? It's the standing still that kills me. My legs get bored long before I do.
dialogue.realtalk.life.first: My story? Born fast, stayed fast. Raced everything — kids, chickens, one very smug goat. Still owe that goat a rematch.
dialogue.realtalk.dreams.first: One dream: outrun a horse. Ten strides, that's all I need. I've already paced the course behind the barn.
dialogue.realtalk.fears.first: Truth? The day my knees quit. Everything I am is in these legs. What's left of me when they slow down?
dialogue.realtalk.feelings.first: You're the only one who keeps up with me, %1$s. In every way that counts. That's rarer than you think.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.personal: Whoa — steep hill for a first run. Train with me a while and we'll climb it together, %1$s.
dialogue.realtalk.deflect.intimate: That question's a marathon and we're still on morning stretches. Keep showing up. You're pacing well.
dialogue.realtalk.gossip.none: Nothing. Quietest week all season. I raced the miller's dog out of sheer boredom. Twice. Won once.
